card.name: Linking words before a drug or noun
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'to', 'receiving' and 'of', and the gap before a syringe size. They sit just before the noun the sentence is about to name, mostly in drug-label text.

modes.label: Patient receiving a drug
modes.description: The word 'receiving' after 'patient' or 'patients', right before a drug name.
modes.example: When such drugs are administered to a patient<< receiving>> Glipizide and Metformin

modes.label: Space before syringe size
modes.description: The space after 'the' just before a syringe volume such as 60 mL.

modes.label: Linking 'of' or 'to' in general prose
modes.description: A linking word such as 'of' or 'to' before a noun phrase, in label or general text.
modes.example: Jefferson's inclination, despite his party's policy<< of>> dismantling the Navy, was to respond
